text: This solution, Technical Disaster Risk Reduction (TDRR) Program addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between Geoscience Australia, Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) Humanitarian Program, PNG Department of Mineral Policy and Geohazards Management (DMPGM), Port Moresby Geophysical Observatory (PMGO), Rabaul Volcano Observatory (RVO), PNG provincial governments, PNG universities, and Community partners such as schools. The program was implemented in 2016 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and leveraging tech.
